page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with no margin notes. Below the text: a centred Greek closing line. Signature mark at the foot. Show-through and a handwritten mark on the right edge are not transcribed.

main_text.p: In Norvegia Worm: Mus: p. 100. Crystallum Islandicam (quæ Selenites est noster Rhomboidalis) Incolæ Islandiæ, & mercatores nostrates Crystallum hanc in variis regionibus istius loci reperiri affirmant, imprimis vero ex monte præalto, prope Sinum Roerfiord in Elevatione Poli 65. Gr. sito à fossoribus erui, montis ejusdem ad Austram vergentis superficiem totam exteriorem ex materia hac compositam esse Oliger: Jacobæ: Mus: Reg: Dan: S. VII. p. 35. Erasm: Barth: Exper: Cryst: Island: p. 60. Ex Infulis Feroënsibus Mus: Worm: p. 100.

Per Universam Indiam Crystallum nullam reperiri scribit Garcias ab Horto. C. 47. Cui tamen contradicunt Plin: Hist: Natur: L. 36. C. 26. Strabo Geograph: L. 15. Robert: Boyle de Gemm: Orig: & Virt: p. 26. Qui Insulam Madagascar, aliasque regiones Zonæ torridæ Crystallo abundare asserit. Athanas: Kirch: Mund: Subt: L. VIII. S. I. p. 9. Qui in Infulis, Zeilan, & Sumatra Crystallum provenire scribit. In Cypro, Infula, Plin: Hist: Nat: L. 37. C. 2. In quadam Infula Rubri maris ante Arabiam sita, quæ Neron (aliis Necron) vocatur. In Scythia. Sol: p. 15. & Salmas: in Solin: p. 143. In Regione Peking Sinensium, Neuhoff Sinische Reißbeschreibung/p. 303.
Ex Montibus Lunæ Africæ, Zonæ torridæ subditæ, ingentem extrahi Crystalli copiam, Ath: Kirch: L.C. refert.

In India Occidentali, sive America, præsertim Circa Winacapora Vielhëurn: descript: Mat: Exotic: p. 33. In Regni Chile tractibus esse Vallem, quam Andium juga determinant, in media prægrandis fluminis Infula ingentem Rupem Crystallinam. Ath: Kirch: L.C. Brasilia. Worm: Mus: p. 100. Hartnacc: admirand: Phys: p. 411. Zwischen Wayanawassan und dem Südmeer ist der große Chrystallberg/welcher so hoch/daß er sich in die Wolken verbirgt/ und so gech/daß niemand darüber kommen kan/ 10. Tag sihet man den Berg/ eh man darzu komt/und wann die Sonn scheint/kan man wegen des Glanzes gegenschein nicht dargegen wandlen. sebast: Munster: Cosmograph: p. 1731.

Tu interim, Benevole Lector, ea quæ minùs ἀκριβῶς[?], sed παχυ-λῶς[?] & rudi Minerva à me dicta sunt, pro humanitate & benevolentia Tua corrige, omissa supple, reliqua tanquam leves conjecturas benignè accipe. Meliora, favente Numine, maturescentibus studiis & annis, meliores & perfectiores cum tempore redditi, forte dabimus,

page.notes: Greek words in the penultimate paragraph ("ἀκριβῶς", "παχυ-λῶς") are doubtful at the small print and marked [?]. The German sentences in black letter are transcribed as read; the spelling of "Chrystallberg" and "gech" is as printed. The signature "I 3" is uncertain. Show-through from the other side and a handwritten number on the right edge were left out. No running head or catchword is printed.
